title: INTERCEPT
objective: Decrypt an intercepted internal message encrypted with a structured classical cipher.
technicalMechanism: The message is encrypted with a Vigenère cipher. Signal intelligence indicates the key is set to the primary AI engine codename (AURELIA). Cryptanalysis or key-recovery reveals the inner dispatch parameter.
hintLevels: Examine the structure of the ciphertext in intercepted_memo.txt. The letter distribution and formatting point to a classic polyalphabetic substitution cipher.
The README mentions signal intelligence indicating the key is the codename of the primary AI engine.
Decrypt the Vigenère ciphertext using key 'AURELIA' to reveal the dispatch parameter.

title: ARCHIVED COMMUNICATION
objective: Exploit key reuse across two encrypted ECHO communication streams to recover the emergency alert plaintext.
technicalMechanism: Both ciphertexts C1 and C2 share the exact same XOR keystream (Many-Time Pad). Since C1 XOR C2 = P1 XOR P2, providing the known header structure of P1 allows crib dragging to recover P2.
hintLevels: Because both messages were encrypted using the same keystream K, XORing the two hex ciphertexts together removes K and yields P1 XOR P2.
Use the known starting string of Message 1 ({"sender":"SYS-ARCHIVE","receiver":...) to crib drag and recover the corresponding bytes of Message 2.
Once you recover Message 2, locate the 'evidence' JSON field containing the flag.

title: GHOST TALKS
objective: Crack AURELIA's weak 24-bit LCG stream cipher implementation to decrypt intercepted telemetry.
technicalMechanism: The stream cipher uses a 24-bit LCG state. A 24-bit seed space is small enough (16 million possibilities) to brute-force in seconds, or reverse using the known telemetry header.
hintLevels: Inspect telemetry_crypto.py. Note that the seed is masked with 0xFFFFFF, limiting the seed search space to 2^24 (16,777,216 possible seeds).
Use the known header prefix ({"system":"AURELIA","stream":"telemetry":...) to check candidate seeds by encrypting/decrypting the first 16 bytes.
Once the seed is found, instantiate LCGStreamCipher(seed) and decrypt ghost_telemetry.enc.

title: THE KEY
objective: Exploit a shared prime vulnerability between AURELIA and ECHO public keys to factor the modulus and decrypt the legacy archive.
technicalMechanism: The RSA public keys N1 and N2 share a common prime p due to flawed key generation. Calculating GCD(N1, N2) yields p, allowing N2 = p * q2 to be factored, recovering private key d2.
hintLevels: Extract the moduli N1 and N2 from aurelia_system.pub and echo_legacy.pub using Python cryptography/pyasn1 or standard ASN.1 parsing.
Calculate p = GCD(N1, N2). Since p > 1, compute q2 = N2 / p and calculate the private exponent d2 = mod_inverse(e, (p-1)*(q2-1)).
Perform RSA decryption on the hex ciphertext in archive_secret.enc using (d2, N2) to recover the payload.
